definitions.definition: Current AuctionSnapshot.location.value category.
definitions.name: auction_location

definitions.definition: Signed (current close - current open) / (current high - current low).
definitions.name: body_range_ratio

definitions.definition: (current close - current VAL price) / (current VAH price - current VAL price).
definitions.name: close_value_position

definitions.definition: Mean over current plus 19 trailing snapshots of location in lower_value, point_of_control, or upper_value; null unless all 20 locations are not no_value.
definitions.name: inside_value_rate_20

definitions.definition: Consecutive observations in the current auction location, reset at every continuity boundary.
definitions.name: location_dwell_bars

definitions.definition: Natural logarithm of current close / previous close; null when either close is non-positive.
definitions.name: log_return_1

definitions.definition: Natural logarithm of current volume / previous volume; null when either volume is non-positive.
definitions.name: log_volume_ratio_1

definitions.definition: (min(current open, current close) - current low) / (current high - current low).
definitions.name: lower_wick_range_ratio

definitions.definition: Maximum current profile-node persistence in bars, or zero when no nodes exist.
definitions.name: max_node_persistence_bars

definitions.definition: Signed (current close - nearest current HVN representative price) / current close; nearest minimizes absolute price distance.
definitions.name: nearest_hvn_distance_close

definitions.definition: Signed (current close - nearest current LVN representative price) / current close; nearest minimizes absolute price distance.
definitions.name: nearest_lvn_distance_close

definitions.definition: (current close - current POC price) / current close.
definitions.name: poc_distance_close

definitions.definition: (current POC price - previous POC price) / previous close.
definitions.name: poc_velocity_close_1

definitions.definition: Current POC-bin volume / current profile total volume.
definitions.name: poc_volume_share

definitions.definition: (current high - current low) / current close.
definitions.name: range_close_fraction

definitions.definition: Square root of the mean squared log return over the 20 trailing one-observation returns.
definitions.name: realized_volatility_20

definitions.definition: Pearson correlation of the 19 lag-one pairs within the 20 trailing log returns; null when either side has zero variance.
definitions.name: return_autocorrelation_1_20

definitions.definition: (current high - max(current open, current close)) / (current high - current low).
definitions.name: upper_wick_range_ratio

definitions.definition: Cardinality of the intersection divided by the union of previous and current inclusive integer value-area bin ranges.
definitions.name: value_area_jaccard_1

definitions.definition: (current value-area midpoint - previous value-area midpoint) / previous close.
definitions.name: value_midpoint_velocity_close_1

definitions.definition: Count of VALUE_REENTRY events over current plus 19 trailing snapshots divided by 20.
definitions.name: value_reentry_rate_20

definitions.definition: (current VAH price - current VAL price) / current close.
definitions.name: value_width_close

definitions.definition: Current log return divided by realized_volatility_20; null when volatility is zero.
definitions.name: volatility_normalized_return_20

definitions.definition: Current volume / median(current plus 19 trailing volumes) - 1; null when the median is zero.
definitions.name: volume_relative_median_20

definitions.definition: (current close - current VWAP) / current close.
definitions.name: vwap_distance_close

definitions.definition: (current VWAP - previous VWAP) / previous close.
definitions.name: vwap_slope_close_1
